ratings.comment: Bill is extremely respected in his field and after taking this course I understand why. As long as you attend lectures (which were amazing), you will do fine in the class. You can be successful even if you don't do all the readings, but definitely try to read the longer assigned books.
The best lecturer I have had so far at UW-Madison. Class was interesting and has changed the way I look at the American landscape.

Bill is a phenomenal professor and I am grateful for the opportunity to take his class. His lectures are interesting and I looked forward to attending them every week. I would recommend printing out the note sheets he provides prior to lecture so you can take note of what he is talking about without writing like crazy. Definitely worth your time.

You. Must. Take. a course with him. Env studies 460 - best course at the UW. It is challenging but I've never learned more from a class. I hadn't given much thought to getting value for the money I put in to taking a class, but it was apparent I received much more in knowledge & thought process growth than I paid for. Awesome experience!

Course is amazing, but name is misleading. By Am. Environ Hist, what he means is Anglo-Environ Hist. some discus of woodland + plains indians in beginning, but only to contrast to anglo-colonists. What about spanish colonization in south west? Impacts of French exploration? More emphasis on indigenous land use? follows a close anglo narrative

Probably the best lecturer that I've had in all my years at UW. Each lecture is a specially-crafted story, and Bill is one of the most knowledgeable people in the world at what he does- he practically invented the field. Would definitely recommend if you have an interest in the environment or history!

Bill is awesome!! Let me tell you, everything I've read here is right: he's the best. Seriously. Every day was like walking into class to watch a documentary. Probably the most eloquent guy I've ever met. He led my discussion and was very welcoming and open in there as well. Tough grader on papers, but definitely worth it. Would recommend!
Bill is a very good lecturer with a lot of knowledge about the topic but sadly, the topic is really, really boring. Still a pretty easy class and had a fun final paper
This class changed the way I see the world. Inspiring, transformative, breathtaking and eye-opening.

Professor Cronon is one of those people who is very smart and he makes sure others know how smart he is. I took the first semester of 469 ever offered, and it was very rough and not well connected, so hopefully they fix that. Instructions are vague, but if you pay attention in lecture you will ace the essays.

Please take this class. It inspired me to double major in conservation biology and history. Hands down one of the best lecturers I have had. Bill cares about students gaining knowledge and perspective. Work hard on your paper, and cram for the exams and you will do well.

If you attend Wisconsin, you are incredibly lucky to have Professor Cronon. He is one of the best professors in the country, and each one of his lectures are rehearsed and perfectly executed. Every lecture was almost like a movie, because made his stories come to life. Incredibly smart and interesting man.

Excellent lecturer. I do think that what we as students are supposed to take away from the class (understanding connections, reading landscapes, making good and well supported arguments, complexity of causality etc.) would be better synthesized in papers than exams- I hated having to cram study a bunch of facts that I will never need to know again.

Smart guy, fun to talk to, and really has an interest and investment in the topic but doesn't try to push his own views and research on his students. The notesheets he gives out are killer (and also available online) so class isn't mandatory but you won't want to miss his brilliance. Tough 6 page paper, but you get to choose your own topic.

He's the best lecturer I've had so far and an absolute genius.  His lectures are right after lunch time and he turns the lights off so it may be tempting to fall asleep, but his sheer brilliance will keep you awake. Single-handedly inspired me to double major with Environmental Studies.
Hands down the most approachable and intriguing professor you'll have in your college career

Not quite the easiest history class but truly fascinating and relevant in today's society. His lectures are more of a story rather than a lecture. Use provided note sheets and underline words he says to meet his "Rule of 2". Midterms and Place Paper were challenging, yet fair. I put minimal effort in and still did decently well.

Absolutely fascinating course. Last day = 5 minute standing ovation (students literally cried). Bill is brilliant- an honor to have him at UW. GET TO KNOW HIM! Note sheets provided so you can really listen. Exams are challenging, but fair. Papers require preparation, but pull the course together. I see the world in an entirely new way. No regrets.

Professor Cronon was clear and eloquent in talking.  He provides note sheets and I found it most helpful to go through and highlight what he mentions. Lecture is 75 minutes and can get long, but if you eat a little snack during the break you should be fine. Learned a lot from this class! Tests are not bad if you study and attend lecture.

Bill is hands down the best professor on campus. His lectures are engaging and the class changes the way you view everyday places, people, and things. If you are on the fence on taking this class, do yourself a favor and take it! You have to put in the work to get an A, but it is worth it! TA Rebecca Summer is great as well.

Lectures are long and boring.  The only class I've ever fallen asleep in.  Talks about a lot of topics that only vaguely connect.  Tests cover a lot of material, requires a good deal of studying.  Don't recommend unless you have an interest in the topic.

Very good lecturer, articulates well, and is good at inserting humor into lecture. That being said, lecture notes were so dense; there was so much material, and at times I was unsure about what was going to be on the exam. Books weren't discussed as much as expected. Exams are fair, but place paper is a headache if you procrastinate like I did.

Great Guy! He keeps everything super interesting and is way over qualified to be teaching! I really enjoyed attending lecture, outside of lecture the discussions were sub-par and readings a bit dry at times, but not all that challenging. BILL IS AWESOME, i really loved to hear his lectures, unlike any others!

When people say Bill is the best lecturer on campus, they mean it. He is the most eloquent man I've ever met and his lectures are like big stories. It would be perfect as a 50 min lecture but it gets boring as a power lecture. Lots of reading and the Place Paper is overwhelming. But I've enjoyed this class way more than I thought

At a giant university like this, 460 might be the only lecture that has 300+ seats for a good reason. Bill is an unmatched lecturer. People that don't even go here come just to see him speak. He doesn't talk about linear causation. To some extent, he wants you to make connections for yourself. It isn't hard to get an A.
The best professor I've ever had. He genuinely loves teaching and has the most lovely lectures. Not an easy course, but I wouldn't change a thing he does.

He definitely knows a lot of stuff and speaks well, but the class really left me confused and without any idea of how I should conceive of nature/environment. I think this is because he's really into the world being complicated, and so presents it as so. Not a bad class, but definitely doesn't live up to all the hype. Take envir. ethics instead....
Extremely interesting. Genuinely committed to students' learning. Lovely language. Wish I could take more of his classes.
honestly the best class and lecturer on campus. You get out what you put in to the class.

Bill is AWESOME and this is the best class I've taken at UW. He's so smart and knows so much about the topic. The way he delivers lectures makes everything so interesting. You will learn things in this class that blow your mind and change the way you think about history and American culture. I DEFINITELY recommend this class!&Brian is an awesome TA

First half of the semester is very boring, the second half is somewhat interesting.  Exams are essay-style, which is pretty lame.  Avoid TA Rachel Gross, she's not a very friendly person.  Overall, it was a decent class, but a serious drag at times.

Bill is extremely intelligent and is one of the founders of the field of environmental history, so naturally he is very knowledgeable about the field. His lectures were a bit tedious for the first couple months, but the second half of the semester was great. Not an easy course. I Recommend it if you are interested in history/geography
Bill is an amazing professor.  His environmental history class will alter the way you look at the world, and the narratives he weaves in class will keep you rapt.

Excellent professor, knows what he's talking about because he practically invented the field. As important as he is, he's not intimidating at all. Great lecturer, and really ties together a lot of complex ideas towards the end of the course.

Everyone should have this professor before they graduate.  He is on a different level than every other instructor I've ever had.  The fact that he was just elected to be the president of the National History Association shows how great he is.  Take his class, it'l be a little tough, but he manages to blow my mind every single lecture.

What makes Bill so his great is not only his wealth of knowledge, but his means of delivering. He provides note sheets for lectures so students can just listen, he understands discussion sections are for improving public speaking skills. Material is easy to follow, but the two exams and 1 paper require much synthesizing. This guy is amazing.

Best history class I've taken on campus. Tremendous passion for the subject, which was much more interesting than I had anticipated. Each lecture felt like listening to a documentary, incredibly engaging and entertaining. Extremely helpful for 2 tests. One 5-6 pg paper, most enjoyable paper I've ever had to write. Take this class!!
He really loves the subject.

Bill Cronon rocks!  He knows Environmental History forwards and backwards, and is one of the leading experts in the field.  He truly cares about what he teaches.  The lectures are engaging and give a very unique historical perspective America.
Awesome lecturer straight out of the History channel...the 8:00 am lectures were bad, but i love the class. It is a very interesting way to think about history

Bill basically invented the field of Environmental History. His lectures miraculously cram an incredible amount of material into an logical flow. His goal is to teach you to organize a mountain of material into themes/stories/patterns. Also, don't pack up early, the last thing is says in each lecture is usually the most important.

Bill Cronon is amazing!  he's a genius and really nice.  the class is relevant and interesting, though the first quarter of it may be difficult for people with no previous interest. basically i wish i could marry him/be him.  though i did hear he has a large and weirdly well organized DVD collection....

THis is by far the best class I have ever taken. Bill's lectures are amazing and I really enjoyed going! Exams weren't bad, he holds a review session before both to prepare you and you get a note sheet during lecture. Take this class!! Bill is sooo smart and definitely gives the best lectures because he loves what he talks about.

I Love Bill Cronon!! He is so intelligent and sweet...Expert in his feild.  Material was infinately interesting i think about it everyday! I fricken loved his class!  Lectures were awesome, discussion with Travis was fun and hes cute!  The paper was very interesting, and you get help to prepare for the exams.

Best class i've had in college!  Cronon's lectures are so wonderful to attend.  Discussions are a waste of time and i stopped going.  He requires a LOT of reading, but there just isn't enough time to do it all, which is ok.  The tests are kind of hard too, but it's so worth it, b/c the class is AMAZING!  btw...  i'm tired of the homeless on state s
"Read my book, read my book, read my book" ...read it, hated it!  Oh yes, he is a picker.
Extremely intelligent, organized and well-spoken.  Worth taking, even for non-majors.
Best class on campus!  Bill is amazing.  He hands out notes during class, so you can listen to his lectures.

He is brillant. The lectures do start to get a little long after the 1 minute break half way through class. The reading load in this class is havy but the work load is not. He wants everyone to succeed. He tells you what to study for the exams and grades very fairly.
The Man.  Cronon is one smart dude, and so interesting I made it to every lecture (a first for this 5th year senior)  As one reviewer said you do read two of his books, but they are worth every page.
very boring lectures; class seemed like vehicle for selling his lame books

I'm in love with Bill Cronon. He is an excellent professor and would recommend his courses to those who may not be particularily interested in that subject...believe me he'll open your eyes and keep you interested throughout the whole course. He's like another smiley grandpa :)

What an incredible class!  Bill is one of the greatest storytellers I've ever heard.  He makes the material so interesting to learn its not even a chore in reading the several book for this class.  I would recommend it to anbody.
Cronon is a ton of fun!  He is a great lecturer and keeps you entertained the whole time.  Pretty much must attend lecture in order to pass the tests.  Requires tons and tons of reading.
excellent professor. easy to listen to. exams are very reasonable and not too hard if you study and go to lecture. disscusions are sort of useless tho.
Great lecturer.
No Comments
His lectures are wonderful, the time flies by.  He's an amazing professor, you should take a class of his if you can.
He pretty much states the obvious about everything and then tries to act like a damned guru.
Probably one of the best classes I've taken at this University. The last lecture is really great and makes you reflect about everything you learn in the class.
No Comments
fast lectures, good class
Lectures are amazing.  He goes fast, but hands out sheets at the beginning.  A wonderful professor and a wonderful class.
Lectures are awesome because it is story time.  Readings are kind of long but easy.  Paper for class is fun and interesting.
Very interesting class.  Great lecturer but can be tough to keep up with.  all in all a great class
Awesome professot.  Makes topic very interesting.  If you go to class, the material is pretty easy to learn.
No Comments
